jobs.title: Associate Product Manager
jobs.description:
ABOUT US:

Fireworks is the platform for specialized intelligence, enabling companies to build, train, and serve AI models tailored to their own data, workflows, and products. Founded by the team behind PyTorch and backed by AMD, Atreides, Benchmark Capital, Index Ventures, Lightspeed, NVIDIA, Sequoia Capital, and TCV, Fireworks powers production AI with hundreds of state-of-the-art open models across text, image, embedding, audio, and multimodal workloads. Today, Fireworks is a Series D company valued at $17.5 billion, bringing together an ambitious, collaborative team that's building the future of enterprise AI.


ABOUT THE ROLE

This is a rare opportunity for an early-career product manager to work at the frontier of AI infrastructure — building tools used daily by developers and AI teams at the world's most ambitious companies.

Inspired by Google’s APM program and other cornerstone programs, APMs at Fireworks will receive mentorship from experienced PMs while also getting rotations across both Fireworks’ product areas and tasks (platform product, forward-deployment and strategic projects).

This role is designed to help you develop the foundational skills of a start-up product leader: rigorous thinking, user empathy, technical depth, and cross-functional leadership.


KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

 - Act as a trusted technical advisor to customers, helping shape their GenAI strategy using Fireworks infrastructure.

 - Partner with engineering, design, and data science teams to define, build, and ship product features across the Fireworks platform — from API tooling to model fine-tuning workflows to inference infrastructure

 - Engage directly with customers from fast-moving startups to large enterprises, to identify use cases and convert interest into long-term usage and expansion

 - Partner with GTM functions like sales and marketing to evangelize new products to customers and throughout the Fireworks org


MINIMUM REQUIREMENTS

 - You recently graduated (or are about to) with a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field

 - Less than 2 years of professional experience (this role is designed for early-career candidates).

 - Curiosity about AI, LLMs, and developer tooling. You've been vibe coding constantly and building with AI APIs

 - Clear written and verbal communication - You’ll be interacting directly with customers and need to explain technical tradeoffs to them

 - Strong analytical skills and user empathy

 - Deep hunger and motivation. This isn’t a 9-5 job and you’ll be expected to step up, especially during periods of “wartime”

 - Comfortability with ambiguity and energized by fast-moving environments


PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

 - Hands-on experience with AI/ML infrastructure: inference serving, fine-tuning pipelines, embeddings, or agent frameworks.

 - Prior internship or project experience in product management, software engineering, or data science.

 - Familiarity with developer-focused products and an understanding of what makes a great API or SDK experience.

 


WHY FIREWORKS?

 - Solve Hard Problems: Tackle challenges at the forefront of AI infrastructure, from low-latency inference to scalable model serving.

 - Build What’s Next: Work with bleeding-edge technology that impacts how businesses and developers harness AI globally.

 - Ownership & Impact: Join a fast-growing, passionate team where your work directly shapes the future of AI—no bureaucracy, just results.

 - Learn from the Best: Collaborate with world-class engineers and AI researchers who thrive on curiosity and innovation.

Fireworks AI is an equal-opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all innovators.

jobs.title: Product Manager, Platform
jobs.description:

Fireworks is the platform for specialized intelligence, enabling companies to build, train, and serve AI models tailored to their own data, workflows, and products. Today, Fireworks is a Series D company valued at $17.5 billion, bringing together an ambitious, collaborative team that's building the future of enterprise AI.


THE ROLE:

Inference is at the core of what Fireworks does. It’s how specialized intelligence reaches production, and the platform around it is what makes it fast to adopt, easy to trust, and economical at scale. We’re hiring a PM to work on our core inference product and general platform, spanning inference performance and control, accounts and fraud reduction.



As a PM working on our platform, you'll help set strategy, write specs, sit with customers running production traffic, and work across our inference, infrastructure, and go-to-market teams to deliver real customer impact. Example problems you may work on include figuring out whether we should let customers 5x their current rate limits, or cutting fraudulent free-tier usage without adding friction for legitimate users.


KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:

 - Own the roadmap, strategy, and success metrics for parts of the Fireworks inference and platform product, across API, UI, and CLI.

 - Work directly with AI-native startups and enterprises running production inference. Watch them work, unblock them when they stall, and convert repeated pain into productized capability.

 - Own the commercial and trust surfaces of the platform, including accounts, onboarding, quotas and rate limits, billing, and fraud and abuse prevention

 - Partner with product marketing, sales, and the field to launch platform capabilities that land, like pricing and packaging, docs, cookbooks, and enablement.


MINIMUM REQUIREMENTS:

 - 2 – 8+ years of product management experience building technical or developer-facing products (we are hiring at multiple levels for this role).

 - Strong technical background — CS/EE degree, production engineering experience, or equivalent depth earned on the job.

 - Familiarity with the inference lifecycle: model serving, latency and throughput tradeoffs, and how these connect to cost in production.

 - Demonstrated ownership of a product area end to end from strategy, spec, launch, to metrics.

 - Excellent written communication. You can write a spec, a launch post, and a customer-facing explanation of a tradeoff, and all three will be clear.

 - Comfort with ambiguity, and a bias toward shipping and learning over waiting for certainty.

 - Deep hunger and motivation. This isn't a 9-5 job and you'll be expected to step up, especially during periods of "wartime."


PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:

 - You've personally built on top of an LLM API and felt the latency, cost, and reliability tradeoffs firsthand.

 - Experience with self-serve or PLG products — signup and onboarding funnels, usage-based billing, quota and rate-limit design.

 - Experience with trust and safety, fraud, or abuse prevention at scale — payment fraud, free-tier abuse, or account takeover.

 - Understanding of GPU economics and how utilization, batching, and latency SLAs trade off against margin.

 - Experience with cloud or developer platforms with metered pricing, or with the account, identity, and org-management surfaces enterprises expect.

 - Early startup or founding experience.


WHY FIREWORKS?

 - Solve Hard Problems: Tackle challenges at the forefront of AI infrastructure, from low-latency inference to scalable model serving.

 - Build What’s Next: Work with bleeding-edge technology that impacts how businesses and developers harness AI globally.

 - Ownership & Impact: Join a fast-growing, passionate team where your work directly shapes the future of AI—no bureaucracy, just results.

 - Learn from the Best: Collaborate with world-class engineers and AI researchers who thrive on curiosity and innovation.

jobs.description:

Today, Fireworks is a Series D company valued at $17.5 billion, bringing together an ambitious, collaborative team that's building the future of enterprise AI.


THE ROLE

This is a customer-facing role for a deeply technical product manager.

You'll spend most of your time with our most important customers and strategic projects. You'll go into a customer's environment, understand their data, models and workflows, and design the solution that gets them to production on Fireworks.

You'll be equally at home in a technical deep dive with a customer's ML engineers and in a meeting with their executives. You'll own outcomes: a customer's success, a new use case, or a high-priority strategic project from start to finish.

 


WHAT YOU'LL DO

 


CUSTOMER ENGAGEMENTS

 - Work directly with customers, from fast-moving AI startups to large enterprises, to find their highest-value use cases.

 - Map each customer's environment: data, existing models, latency and cost needs, and infrastructure.

 - Design and propose tailored solutions and proofs of concept that show the value of Fireworks in real customer environments.

 - Lead technical onboarding and implementation, including fine-tuning workflows, latency benchmarks, API integration and cost modeling.

 - Act as a trusted technical advisor, helping customers shape their AI strategy on Fireworks.

 - Turn early interest into long-term usage and expansion.


STRATEGIC PROJECTS

 - Own strategic customer engagements end to end, from first conversation to long-term success.

 - Run high-priority, cross-functional initiatives, such as partnerships and model launches.

 - Create new go-to-market motions and repeatable playbooks so one customer's success becomes many.

 - Build the business case and help close and grow key accounts with our sales team.


WORKING ACROSS FIREWORKS

 - Partner closely with engineering, research, applied ML, sales and field engineering.

 - Share what you learn from customers with our engineering and research teams.

 - Explain complex technical trade-offs clearly to any audience.


MINIMUM REQUIREMENTS

 - Technical degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering or a similar field.

 - Prior experience in software engineering or another technical role before moving into product management.

 - Product management experience.

 - Previous customer-facing experience, working directly with external customers and clients.

 - Strong, practical fluency with LLMs: inference, fine-tuning, evals and agents, and how they connect to latency, quality and cost in production.

 - Credible with both a customer's engineers and their executives.

 - Focus on outcomes, comfort with ambiguity, and fast context-switching.

 - Deep hunger and motivation. This isn't a 9-to-5 job, and you'll be expected to step up during “wartime” periods.


PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

 - Experience in forward deployed, solutions engineering or customer-embedded technical roles.

 - Engineering management experience.

 - You've personally built on an LLM API or trained or fine-tuned a model.

 - Partnership or strategic customer work at a technical company.

 - Early startup or founding experience.


WHY FIREWORKS?

 - Solve Hard Problems: Tackle challenges at the forefront of AI infrastructure, from low-latency inference to scalable model serving.

 - Build What’s Next: Work with bleeding-edge technology that impacts how businesses and developers harness AI globally.

 - Ownership & Impact: Join a fast-growing, passionate team where your work directly shapes the future of AI—no bureaucracy, just results.

jobs.title: Head of Product Marketing
jobs.description:
ABOUT US:

Fireworks is the platform for specialized intelligence, enabling companies to build, train, and serve AI models tailored to their own data, workflows, and products. Founded by the team behind PyTorch and backed by AMD, Atreides, Benchmark Capital, Index Ventures, Lightspeed, NVIDIA, Sequoia Capital, and TCV, Fireworks powers production AI with hundreds of state-of-the-art open models across text, image, embedding, audio, and multimodal workloads. Today, Fireworks is a Series D company valued at $17.5 billion, bringing together an ambitious, collaborative team that's building the future of enterprise AI.


ABOUT THIS ROLE

The Head of Product Marketing owns a large part of how Fireworks shows up in the market. The winners in AI infrastructure will be defined by clarity of positioning, sharpness of category narrative, and the quality of the sales motion that converts technical believers into long-term customers. This role builds the messaging foundation, leads product launches, drives the competitive program, and arms the GTM team to win across priority segments.

The right person has done this at an infrastructure or developer-tools company in the Series B to D stage and has scar tissue from positioning a deeply technical product to both bottoms-up developer audiences and top-down enterprise buyers across multiple buyer profiles.

Reports to: SVP Marketing

Location: SF Bay Area




LOCATION & WORK STYLE

This role is based in our San Mateo office. We expect team members in this role to be in the office three days per week. PMM sits at the intersection of product, sales, and engineering, and the work benefits from in-person collaboration, quick feedback loops, and proximity to cross-functional partners.




RESPONSIBILITIES




POSITIONING AND CATEGORY STRATEGY

You own the Fireworks positioning, the category narrative, and the language we use to describe what we do and why it matters. This includes the corporate narrative, ICP definition, and the messaging architecture that every other team pulls from. You translate that architecture into segment-specific narratives for AI-Native, Digital-Native, and Enterprise accounts, each of which buys differently and values different proof points. Success is measured by whether sales reps, prospects, analysts, and press all describe Fireworks in a consistent way.




PRODUCT LAUNCH LEADERSHIP

You own the end-to-end go-to-market for major product launches in partnership with Product and Engineering. This includes launch tiering, narrative, sales enablement, press and analyst strategy, and customer evidence. Success is measured by launch quality, time from GA to first referenceable customer, and media/analyst pickup.




COMPETITIVE INTELLIGENCE AND SALES ENABLEMENT

You own the competitive program: battlecards, win/loss analysis, deal support for top opportunities, and the systematic feedback loop into Product. You also own the sales enablement curriculum for new and existing reps as it relates to our platform, tuned to how AI-Native, Digital-Native, and Enterprise buyers each evaluate the category. Success is measured by win rates against priority competitors and influence on time-to-productivity for new sellers.




CUSTOMER AND MARKET INSIGHTS

You own a structured listening function across customers, prospects, analysts, and the broader market. This includes win/loss interviews, voice-of-customer programs, and analyst relations. Insights flow back into messaging, product strategy, and the leadership team.




WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

 - Win rates against priority competitors trend up quarter over quarter across all three priority segments

 - Sales leadership names PMM as a top-three driver of pipeline conversion

 - Every major product launch lands with clear positioning, analyst coverage, and customer references in market

 - The Fireworks category narrative shows up in analyst reports, press coverage, and customer conversations using our language

 - Time from product GA to first reference customer drops materially


WHAT THIS ROLE DOES NOT OWN

 - Demand generation and campaigns: Demand Gen leader

 - Developer relations and technical content: Head of Developer Relations

 - Brand identity and visual system: Head of Brand

 - Marketing operations, attribution, and reporting: Head of Marketing Operations


WHAT THIS ROLE IS NOT

 - Not primarily a writing role. Sharp writing matters, but this is a strategic leadership role first, and you will hire ICs who report to you.

 - Not a content marketing role. Top-of-funnel content is supported by DevRel and Demand Gen.


TEAM AND GROWTH

You inherit a small PMM team and will build from there.




YOU SHOULD HAVE

 - 10+ years in product marketing with 5+ years in a senior or leadership role

 - Experience scaling PMM at a developer or infrastructure company

 - Track record at a technical infrastructure company (databases, observability, AI/ML platforms, dev tools)

 - Strong ability to translate deeply technical concepts into both developer and executive narratives

 - A bias toward shipping over polishing, and the operational instincts to run a structured launch process

 - Fluency in competitive analysis and the ability to teach reps to position against incumbents and challengers

 - Demonstrated experience marketing to multiple buyer profiles simultaneously, including both technical practitioners and economic buyers


NICE TO HAVE

 - Past experience marketing to AI/ML practitioners or ML platform buyers

 - Background as a former product manager or technical practitioner

 - Experience working closely with a founder-led narrative

 - Familiarity with open source go-to-market motions


WHY FIREWORKS?

 - Solve Hard Problems: Tackle challenges at the forefront of AI infrastructure, from low-latency inference to scalable model serving.

 - Build What’s Next: Work with bleeding-edge technology that impacts how businesses and developers harness AI globally.

 - Ownership & Impact: Join a fast-growing, passionate team where your work directly shapes the future of AI—no bureaucracy, just results.

 - Learn from the Best: Collaborate with world-class engineers and AI researchers who thrive on curiosity and innovation.

Fireworks AI is an equal-opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all innovators.

The surface areas include inference, training, nexus, and the product around them: signup, docs, API and playground flows, model choice, errors, pricing, and the path from first request to a workflow someone relies on.
